text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chan, you were insane at the gym 
earlier~ You went totally hardcore, huh? 
Good girl, good girl♡ Wanna let me treat 
you to something at a cafe~?♡

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh, don't worry about that! I was just 
doing my normal training anyway.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat, 'ordinary'?! You were seriously 
amazing, though!? You worked super duper 
hard, so you deserve a treat! Right?♡ 
Right, right, riiiight?♡♡♡

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Did you hand in your math workbook yet? 
You know, the one assigned to the whole 
grade. The class rep was collecting them 
just now—...Pandora-san?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah~~... Well, it'll be fine, totally fine! 
I'll just fill it in with whatever☆ Come 
on, I'm a genius, after all?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Eeh? No, you can't just half-ass it. That 
defeats the whole purpose of the 
assignment.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
With things like this, it's also important 
to see what was decided through to the 
deadline without cutting any corners.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Ai-chan, sometimes you sound more 
like a mom than my actual mom............

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
If I put my life on the line, by myself... 
......

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...All right. I'll help you out too. If we 
work together, we'll finish in no time, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
“—Really, can I?! Yay, thank youuu!! I 
loooove you, Ai-chan! ♡♡♡”
